rescaled_units: m=1, g4=1, g6=beta; lengths 1/m, field m/sqrt(g4), E m/g4, N 1/g4
tail_definition: Phi -> A exp(-kappa r)/r, kappa = sqrt(m^2-omega^2); A = mean of r Phi exp(kappa r) over tail_window (1e-9 < Phi/Phi0 < 1e-3, r < 0.8 R_box); A_rel_spread = std/mean there; kappa_fit = free log-linear fit

solver.method: scipy solve_bvp collocation, Robin tail BC at R_box

checks_wpA.dEdw_rows_note: finite differences on the non-uniform row grid; the relative form diverges where dE/domega -> 0 at the minimum, so the worst row value is a grid statement, the central differences are the check
